comparison.objective: Unload a soup tray from a pass and serve the bowl; candidate adjusts a robot gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Level bimanual tray transport and spill avoidance versus concentric tool seating and reaction-preserving locknut tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Tray flat, bowl placed, and limited spill versus locked 90° opening retained through three cycles.
comparison.reason: Transporting a loaded tray does not test threaded adjustment retention or countertorque.
